/politica-de-privacidad/.title: Privacy policy
/politica-de-privacidad/.lead: When you ask us for a quote, when José comes to your site to measure, or when you browse this website, we receive some of your data. This page explains which data, what for, and how to ask us to correct or delete it.
/politica-de-privacidad/.body:
Who is responsible

MÁS VIDRIOS is the trade name of José Victoriano Caballero Rojas, a family glass and aluminium business based in San Lorenzo, Central Department, Paraguay.

For any privacy matter, write to jose@masvidrios.com.py or to 0984 452 749. We are open Monday to Friday from 7:30 to 17:30 and Saturdays from 7:30 to 12:00.

What data we receive

  • When you write to us or use the form: the form on this site stores nothing; it builds a message and opens it in your WhatsApp so you can send it yourself. We receive your name, your number, the job you need and any photos or measurements you choose to send.
  • When we come to measure: the address of the site or your home, the time to visit, and the measurements and photos of the place where the job goes.
  • When you hire us: your billing details (name or company name, ID card or RUC).
  • When you visit the site: browsing data from the measurement tools listed below.

What we use it for

  • Sending you the quote and arranging the measuring visit. Legal basis: the pre-contract steps you ask for.
  • Making, installing and servicing the job, and honouring the warranty. Legal basis: performance of the contract.
  • Invoicing. Legal basis: legal obligation.
  • Improving the site with statistics that do not show your name. Legal basis: legitimate interest. You can object at any time.

The photos of jobs on this site and on our social media are of our own work, published with the owners' permission. If you would rather we did not publish yours, or want it taken down, tell us.

Tools and cookies on this site

  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): visit and usage statistics. Google's privacy policy · how Google uses data from sites that use its services.
  • Microsoft Clarity (Microsoft Corporation): heatmaps and session recordings, a replay of how each page is browsed. Microsoft and we capture usage data of the site through behavioral metrics, heatmaps and session replay, with first and third party cookies. Microsoft privacy statement.
  • Google Maps (Google LLC): the map of the area. Google receives your IP address when it loads.

They process data outside Paraguay. To refuse them, you can block or delete cookies in your browser, browse in private mode, or use the Google Analytics opt-out add-on. The site works the same without cookies.

Who we share it with

  • The MÁS VIDRIOS team that measures, makes and installs your job.
  • The tempering plant, which receives the measurements of the pieces, without your personal data.
  • The providers of the site's tools, which receive browsing data only.
  • The services we use to work: Cloudflare (site hosting), Zoho (email) and WhatsApp (conversations).
  • Public authorities, when a law or a court order requires it.

Outside those cases, your data stays with us.

How long we keep it

  • Quotes that did not go ahead: up to two years, in case you come back. Sooner, if you ask us to delete them.
  • Completed jobs: for as long as the warranty lasts, and then for the period tax law requires invoices to be kept.
  • Measurement data: the period set by each tool. In Google Analytics, 14 months.

Your rights

You can ask us, free of charge and at any time, to know what data of yours we hold, to correct it, to delete it once it is no longer needed, to stop using it for measurement or messages, for a copy in a common format, or to withdraw a consent.

Write to jose@masvidrios.com.py. We may ask for a detail to confirm it is you, and we answer within 30 calendar days at most. You also have the habeas data action before the courts (article 135 of the National Constitution) and, once it is operating, a complaint before the National Personal Data Protection Agency within MITIC.

If a security incident affecting your data ever happened, we would tell you and the supervisory authority within the periods set by law.

Laws and changes

This policy follows the National Constitution, Law 1682/2001 on private information and its amendments, Law 4868/2013 on Electronic Commerce and Law 7593/2025 on Personal Data Protection, which takes full effect in November 2027 and which we already apply.

If we change it, we update the date. Last updated: October 1, 2026.

/terminos/.title: Terms and conditions
/terminos/.lead: How to ask for a quote, how the job is made and installed, what the warranty covers and where to complain. None of these rules takes away the rights given by Law 1334/98 on Consumer Protection.
/terminos/.body:
Who we are

MÁS VIDRIOS is the trade name of José Victoriano Caballero Rojas, based in San Lorenzo, Central Department, Paraguay. WhatsApp 0984 452 749, email jose@masvidrios.com.py. Monday to Friday from 7:30 to 17:30 and Saturdays from 7:30 to 12:00.

We make and install made-to-measure work in tempered, laminated and double glazed glass, aluminium windows and doors, enclosures, shower screens, partitions, railings, mirrors, ceilings, polycarbonate and automatic doors, and we do service and maintenance. We work in San Lorenzo and all of Greater Asunción.

How to ask for a quote

  • Write to us by WhatsApp, through the form or by email and tell us what you need.
  • We arrange a visit: José goes to your site or your home to see the place and take the measurements. The quoting visit is free.
  • We send you the quote in writing, with no commitment. It states what will be done, with which glass, thickness, profiles and fittings, the price, the payment terms, the delivery time, how long the quote is valid and the warranty (Law 1334/98, article 15).
  • The job is confirmed when you accept the quote and the first payment stated in it is received.

Prices and payments

Prices are in guaraníes, VAT included, and are valid for the period stated in the quote. The payment terms, for example a deposit and the balance on completion, are in the quote. You get a legal invoice for every payment. Once accepted, the price does not change on our side.

If, while installing, something comes up that could not be seen when measuring and extra work is needed, we explain it and give you the cost before doing it (Law 1334/98, article 16).

Manufacturing and installation

Tempered glass is cut and tempered at the plant to the exact measurements we take, so the lead time depends on the plant and on the type of job; the lead time for your job is the one in the quote. If it is going to change, we tell you the new date.

To install, we need access to the place and the building work at the stage stated in the quote (for example, plastering finished). When we finish, we leave the place clean.

Care and safety

Tempered glass is safety glass: if it breaks from an extreme impact, it shatters into small pieces without sharp edges. Even so, it cannot be cut or drilled after tempering, and hard knocks on the edges should be avoided. Laminated glass is used for façades and glass roofs. We tell you which one goes where. If you have questions about use or cleaning, ask us.

Warranty

Every job comes with a written warranty. The quote and the receipt state its period, what it covers (manufacturing, installation, fittings and profiles), where to claim it and any cost on your side (Law 1334/98, article 11).

The warranty does not cover breakage from impacts, misuse, movements of the building's structure or work done by third parties on what we installed. In those cases we give you a quote for the repair.

If you want to cancel or change your mind

  • Before accepting the quote, you can withdraw at no cost.
  • If you signed at your home or at your site, you have 7 days from signing to withdraw and get back what you paid (Law 1334/98, article 26).
  • If you hired us at a distance, by WhatsApp or phone, you have 5 business days to change your mind (Law 4868/2013, article 30).
  • Jobs are made to your measurements. Once the pieces are cut and tempered, the law allows the distance withdrawal right not to apply (Law 4868/2013, article 31). A cancellation at that point is settled according to the materials already made, with the detail in writing.

Your copy of what was agreed

The accepted quote, the warranty receipt and the invoices are your copy of what was agreed. We send you a copy whenever you ask.

Site content

The photos are of our own work. The texts, the logo and the MÁS VIDRIOS brand are ours. Inova, Gold and Alpha are aluminium lines of their manufacturers. You can share the links freely; to use the content elsewhere, ask us first.

Your data

How we handle your data is explained in the privacy policy, which is part of these terms.

Complaints

Write to us first at 0984 452 749 or jose@masvidrios.com.py. If we cannot reach an agreement, you can file a complaint with the Consumer and User Protection Secretariat, SEDECO (sedeco.gov.py). The authority that enforces Law 4868/2013 on Electronic Commerce is the Ministry of Industry and Commerce (mic.gov.py). None of this prevents you from going to court.

Applicable law and changes

These terms are governed by the laws of Paraguay, in particular Law 1334/98 and Law 4868/2013. The Spanish version is the one that governs.

If we change them, we update the date. Changes do not affect quotes already accepted. Last updated: October 1, 2026.
